## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: new capability
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: documentation
- [ ] `test`: tests only
- [ ] `refactor`: behavior-preserving change
- [ ] `chore` / `ci`: tooling or infrastructure

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `make check` locally.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]` for user-visible changes.
- [ ] I did not commit generated `out/` files or `CONTRACT.md` files.
- [ ] Any new task has no remaining `TODO` placeholders.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the change.
